title: Case Series on Initial Responses to Intravitreal Brolucizumab in Patients with Recalcitrant Chronic Wet Age-Related Macular Degeneration

license.statement: CC BY-NC 3.0 (article <license>, Dove Medical Press terms)

condition: Recalcitrant chronic wet AMD (declining or non-improving vision while on aflibercept or bevacizumab), switched to intravitreal brolucizumab; retrospective chart review case series of 6 eyes of 6 patients; follow-up 2 and 4 weeks after the first brolucizumab injection

groups.agent: brolucizumab intravitreal (Beovu), switch from aflibercept or bevacizumab
groups.description: Whole case series; one brolucizumab injection within the reported 4-week period

series.notes: Per-eye values; the visit labelled '1 month s/p' is described in the case text as 4 weeks post-injection (4 weeks used); no 2-week visit; previously on monthly aflibercept with an earlier bevacizumab period
Per-eye values; 2 weeks and 4 weeks ('1 month s/p') after the injection; previously on monthly aflibercept
Per-eye values; 2 weeks and 4 weeks ('1 month s/p') after the injection; previously treated with bevacizumab at irregular intervals with long gaps in follow-up

Per-eye values; 2 weeks and 4 weeks ('1 month s/p') after the injection; previously on monthly aflibercept; chronic uveitis with earlier dexamethasone implants and a fluocinolone acetonide implant three months before baseline; high myopia; an inflammatory component of the edema was not ruled out by the authors
Per-eye values; 2 weeks and 4 weeks ('1 month s/p') after the injection; previously on bevacizumab then aflibercept with yearly verteporfin PDT; topical difluprednate and bromfenac as adjunct therapy

exclusions.reason: Values flagged by the authors (Table 1 footnote *) as affected by an OCT artifact over the fovea; the authors monitored APT instead, so they are not valid central thickness measurements

exclusions.what: APT column (average pericentral thickness of the 4 quadrants adjacent to the central region)
exclusions.reason: Ring/sector subfield without the central value; out of scope

exclusions.what: Visual acuity and change in VA columns

notes: Measure: CMT by Cirrus OCT 5000 without a subfield definition: central_unspecified, device cirrus.

Time origin: the first brolucizumab injection (switch visit); the '2 weeks s/p' visit = 14/30.4375 months; the '1 month s/p' visit is reported in each case description and the abstract as 4 weeks post-injection = 28/30.4375 months.
Kind individual: Table 1 gives one block of rows per eye (case number spans its rows).
Role control: brolucizumab was an approved agent at the time; case series without an investigational arm.
